metadata.description: Skills for building on Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced and migrating from Salesforce CPQ.

plugins.name: rc-core
plugins.description: Grounding layer. Builds and refreshes the verified Revenue Cloud knowledge pack from the official developer guide plus a live org fingerprint. Every other rc-* plugin reads it.

plugins.name: rc-migrate
plugins.description: Salesforce CPQ to Revenue Cloud Advanced: extraction, discovery, requirements, solution design and migration plan.

plugins.name: rc-build
plugins.description: Build on Revenue Cloud Advanced: catalog, selling models, pricing, bundles, billing and invoicing.

plugins.name: rc-labs
plugins.description: Tactical Revenue Cloud skills and troubleshooting for one problem at a time.

plugins.name: rc-accelerate
plugins.description: Delivery management for a Revenue Cloud engagement: tracker, test plan and quote-to-cash test harness.
